title: Adaptive Preflight Scan Runner for Version Channels
creator: Priya Menon
description: Introduce an automated preflight runner (Adaptive Preflight Scan, APS) that composes smoke, perf regression, and eval suites into a single verdict job per release candidate. APS adapts test sampling and resource allocation based on recent production telemetry (latency/throughput distributions and error signals) and the target release channel (canary, LTS, stable). Goal: reduce false positives from noisy workloads, catch regressions early, and make gates actionable for rollouts across channels.
acceptance_criteria: APS can be triggered from CI and from the Console release pipeline (route: ci/preflight/aps-run)

APS selects a representative sample of workload traces using telemetry heuristics (95th-pct lat buckets, top3-heavy request paths) and runs smoke + perf + eval suites against the candidate and baseline builds

Perf gate evaluates 3 signals (p95 latency, token throughput, end-to-end error rate) with channel-specific thresholds: canary: p95 delta < 15%, throughput delta < 12%, errors delta < 1%; LTS: p95 delta < 10%, throughput delta < 8%, errors delta < 0.5%
APS posts a structured JSON verdict to the release orchestration API with metric diffs, failing tests, and suggested rollback reason codes
Console displays APS results on a per-release dashboard with links to raw traces and artifactized diffs
APS job is resilient: retries transient infra failures, marks gating failures as actionable (with runbook links) rather than flaky noise
plan: Design: finalize telemetry sampling heuristics and channel thresholds (doc: Confluence APS design)
Implementation: create a lightweight runner image (redwood/aps-runner:v0.1) that orchestrates suites and collects metrics via exporters
Integration: add CI job ci/preflight/aps-run that can be invoked by GH Actions and by the Console release flow
Automation: implement adaptive sample selector service (adapter) that queries the metrics store and returns N representative traces for the run
Gating: implement rule engine to compute diffs and apply channel-specific thresholds; generate structured verdict JSON
Observability: wire APS metrics to the release-dashboard and add tracing breadcrumbs to Console for debugging
Runbook & Rollout: write runbook for interpreting gates and automated rollback triggers for Dedicated customers
